title: cryptids.xyz
tagline: Collectible trading card game & rules engine using ZK proofs & XMTP
description: Cryptids is a Web3 trading card game which allows users to design their own card collections, register, discover challengers, and play using their Ethereum wallet. Deploying to Optimism and Polygon, Cryptids supports ENS, stores assets using Web3.Storage, uses XMTP for communication, and Mina proofs for gameplay.
how_its_made: This project presents a dashboard allowing users to create a card collection using Dall-E, storing assets using web3.storage. Users can configure operations per-card and design a MTG style trading card collection. Then, using a simple registration contract & XMTP, users can discover and challenge each other to a game. Games will be recorded using Mina proofs.
